note: The classic early-game power spike — an Onix well above your level, and it can be traded straight into a Steelix later.
The mirror of Kiki's trade — hand back an Onix for a Bellsprout if you want the Grass line instead.
A Machop for a Drowzee just outside Goldenrod — a strong Fighting start that evolves into Machoke, then Machamp by trade.
Goldenrod's Drowzee-for-Machop counterpart, in the Name Rater's neighbourhood.
Trade a wild Krabby for a Voltorb by the Olivine market — handy Electric coverage before Jasmine.
A Machop offered for a Haunter — since Haunter evolves by trade, this doubles as a way to see one evolve on the way out.
Late-game novelty trade — swap a Dragonair for a Dodrio in the dragon town.
The value trade: the Rattata you receive is holding a Nugget — trade it, sell the Nugget, keep the profit.
A Kangaskhan for a Slowpoke — a rare, otherwise Safari-only catch handed to you for a common Water-type.
A second Onix trade for the common Pidgey — a cheap way to grab the Rock-type if you missed Kiki's.
High-end trade — an Aerodactyl for a Chansey, both prizes in their own right.
Swap a Grimer for a Tangela near Fuchsia — a solid bulky Grass-type for the back half of Kanto.
